messages:
Priya: Heads-up: planning a coordinated base-image rebuild next Tue. Requirement: every promoted image must be cosign-attested with the org KMS key and include SBOM before canary. Need a tight RBAC proposal + audit sinks. Any immediate blockers?
Devon: Ack. Which KMS key/SA? We should scope binding to the specific cryptoKey and grant sign-only.
Priya: Key: kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/image-signer. Signer SA: image-builder@redwood-prod.svc. Principle: least-priv — sign only.
Alex: For GCP, grant roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier on the single cryptoKey resource. Do NOT grant roles/cloudkms.admin or keyAdmin. Also enable KMS Admin activity logs + Data Access for storage writes and sink to security project index `image-sign-*` with 1y retention.
Julia: CI snippet for sign + attestation: 
```
# after build + sbom generation
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key "kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/image-signer" --attestation att.json gcr.io/redwood/base:${TAG}
```
Also add verify in canary: `cosign verify --key <kms://...> gcr.io/...` and check attestation fields (build_id, git_sha, builder_sa, sbom_hash).
Sam: Scan found a transitive glibc CVE in current base. If rebuild pulls patched packages we can proceed, but request a 24h canary hold + full vuln scan before prod.
oncall-sre: If key compromise suspected -> we need runtime enforcement. We cant remove signatures; plan to maintain an allowlist of approved image digests in admission controller and support an emergency denylist. How do we update that quickly?
Devon: I'll add an API-backed allowlist/denylist entry flow in the runtime controller and a short terraform PR to scope the IAM binding to the single key. Also prepare a one-page runbook for emergency key rotation + allowlist updates.
Priya: Audit trail + alerts: Alex, can you create the sink and add an alert for any IAM binding change on the cryptoKey + anomalous access patterns (signer SA using key outside CI window)?
Alex: Yup. I'll create sink `security-image-sign-sink` to security project, index `image-sign-%{+YYYY.MM}` and wire alert rule for IAM change + >3 sign ops/min from a single principal. Posting details by EOD.
Julia: Also recommend CI requires cosign verification and sbom hash match as a gating step in canary pipeline. If verification fails, fail promotion and auto-open a PR to block rollout.
Sam: I'll run the signed-canary scan once CI finishes and post package-diff here. If any criticals remain I will flag hold.
ci-bot: build queued gcr.io/redwood/base:20260518  job=9981
ci-bot: build finished: success (5m)  pushed tag
Devon: Action items: 1) terraform IAM change (sign-only on single key) + PR (devon) — target EOD; 2) runtime allowlist/denylist quick API + runbook (devon) — PR by tomorrow; 3) cosign verify + sbom check in canary (julia) — PR by tomorrow; 4) log sink + alert (alex) — post sink name by EOD; 5) vuln diff after signed canary (sam).
Priya: Thanks. If Sam finds any criticals we pause and triage in this thread. Otherwise, we proceed with canary hold window. :thumbsup:
